summary.name: BeliefState
summary.one_liner: BeliefState is a research API and hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants dated, source-linked investor theses, price targets, catalysts, risks and revisions for stocks.
use_cases: Asking an AI assistant to compare analyst theses on a stock before trading
Pulling price targets and bull/base/bear scenarios into an AI model
Checking how past analyst stock calls performed versus SPY
Tracking when analyst views or price targets change
Feeding cited investment research into an AI workflow via API or MCP
summary.what_it_does: The page describes BeliefState as a way to connect AI assistants to dated, source-linked investor theses, including price targets, forecasts, catalysts and risks extracted from analyst research. Access is offered through a research API and a hosted MCP server, so users can ask a ticker question in their AI and receive cited records. Example entries show a dated thesis with base, bull and bear scenario ranges and a valuation multiple (EV/EBITDA). It also includes a stock-call performance view that compares a hypothetical return on a stock call with SPY over the same period, showing source and entry assumptions. Coverage checks are stated to be free, and research requests are billed as credits.
notable: Hosted MCP server and research API for connecting AI assistants to analyst theses
Dated, source-linked theses with base, bull and bear scenarios and what would break the thesis
Stock-call performance view comparing hypothetical returns with SPY
Free coverage checks; 5 free research requests on sign-up
caveats: Research requests use credits; AI questions may use several credits per request
Pay-as-you-go plan listed at $20 paid once for 1,000 successful research requests; subscription tiers (Starter, Pro, Commercial) are mentioned without prices on the page
Scenario ranges are described as scenarios, not targets
